LightningComponentBundle.description: Searches Products by name or SKU, picks several and takes a quantity for each. Returns the picks as Asset records (Product, Name, Quantity).

property.name: required
property.label: Required
property.description: True to require at least one product.

property.name: selectedItems
property.label: Selected Products
property.description: One Asset per picked product: Product2Id, Name (product name) and Quantity. Map in and out so the picks survive a refused save.
